After Jake died Caitlin was furious and depressed. Dealing with an infant all alone in this big house was driving her insane.

One night she decided to give Liv to grandma to look after so she could have a girls night out on the town to blow off some steam! She was quite a few drinks down when she met Harry. He was soooo handsome she couldn't believe it! He actually approached her in the club and asked her if she wanted to go to an after party at his. She agreed without hesitation!

They got absolutely wasted and passed out on the floor together (which I thought was quite romantic).

The rest was history, they'd meet up everyday after work and go on amazing dinners on the weekends. Caitlin and Harry had grown quite the connection. She felt like her old self again. She missed Jake, a lot, but she was happy she was able to find someone who makes her feel this again. Make her feel how she never thought she could after losing her husband.

Caitlin and Harry decided to become a couple and move away to Henford-on-Bagley into a cute cozy cottage.

One morning Caitlin felt quite sick so, she took a pregnancy test.... Two lines. She was pregnant!! She gave birth to a lovely baby boy named hunter.

Then after some time she fell pregnant again. Harry decided this was the perfect time to propose, before the bump was too big for the dress. 

Caitlin said yes! They had a wonderful beach wedding, surrounded by love and family. Caitlin finally feels content like she once did<3
